build_sparse_convnext_backbone: build a SparseConvNeXt backbone model with configurable architecture for sparse vision transformer pretraining
create_sparse_convnext_block: create a SparseConvNeXtBlock with depthwise conv, sparse layernorm, and pointwise conv layers
convert_dense_to_sparse: convert a dense PyTorch Conv2d, MaxPool2d, or AvgPool2d module to its sparse equivalent
run_sparse_convnext_forward: run forward pass through SparseConvNeXt stages with optional global average pooling before output
review_sparse_convnext_architecture: review the SparseConvNeXt architecture settings including depths, channels, and stage configuration
